name: paypal-pact-harness-cd
description: Consumer-driven contract testing (Pact BDC) for PayPal, wired for Harness. Self-contained: engine source + tests + the vendored, install-free bundle the pipelines call. The 'broker' is a git-backed ledger (can-i-deploy). No box.

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run check && npm run build:bundle && npm run package:bundle && npm run test:packed
